title: Use remarketing with search results
body:
We want to use Google Adwords Dynamic Remarketing with our search results. Is there functionality available for this? Or do we need to custom build something? And if so, what is the best way to implement this?

See https://support.google.com/adwords/answer/3103357?hl=en retail section for more info please.

comments.body:
Hi @Maaark we do not have anything builtin with google adwords but we are very interested in the needs you have.

I have no knowledge at all about google adword or the page you linked unfortunately so you will have to explain it to me a bit more in detail what is it you want to achieve.

Can you detail a bit more for example what are the type of calls you would want to do to google adwords and how it relates to instantsearch.js/search?

Thanks
So let's say I type "mp3" in a product search interface, I get ten different mp3 players, you want to send all of their ids to google adwords. Is that it?
